relevance_note: The paper describes three LAD-1 patients with ITGB2 (CD18) mutations individually, e.g. 'patient 1 had a novel homozygous missense mutation A>C at nt 392, resulting in Y131S', plus four other genotyped LAD-1 patients (subjects A-D).
method_note: Read the full paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON from hand-written values and checked spans. In scope: patients 1-3 (first-hand), their parents (two per patient; tested), and four other LAD-1 patients examined at the same center (Subjects A-D). Labels 'patient 1-3' follow the paper's most frequent form (lowercase). Parents have no stated sex, so 'parent of patient N' and 'parent of patient N 2'. Somatic revertant changes found only in sorted CD18+ T-cell subsets (patient 1 Y131F / A>T nt 392; patient 2 G284R via G>C nt 850 and C>G nt 852; patient 3 reversion of 741-14C>A to wild type) are not germline variants and were NOT recorded as variant rows; they are described in Table 1 'Reversion' column and Results. R586W (C>T nt 1756) in patient 3 is called a 'polymorphism' by the authors and was left out. Patient 3's 741-14C>A allele: the paper says 'The maternal mutant allele carried the polymorphism' and separately that R586W lies on the 741-14 allele; joining these to call 741-14C>A maternally inherited would be an inference, so inheritance is 'not reported' with both statements in parental_testing_statement. Patients 1 and 2 are homozygous with both parents heterozygous; the inheritance enum has no biparental value, so 'inherited unspecified parent' was used. Variant strings keep the paper's notation (no c./p. prefixes; legacy numbering per Figure 2 legend 'calculated from the beginning of the signal sequence'); '>' is kept as it appears in the Markdown. cdna_hgvs_as_stated holds the paper's nucleotide description even though no 'c.' prefix is printed. Subject C carries citations 16,34 and patients 2 and 3 carry citations (17,20,24-26; 27,28; 21), but all are described first-hand at this center, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported'; the citations are in publications.prior_report_citation. Patient 1 umbilical stump separation 'at 10 weeks' was marked observed for 'delayed umbilical cord separation' although the word 'delayed' is not printed. Patient 2 'removal of all permanent teeth' was marked observed for 'tooth loss' (iatrogenic removal). Contradiction noted: the Discussion says all 3 patients 'survived into adulthood without allogeneic bone marrow transplants', while patient 1 had a matched unrelated bone marrow transplantation at age 21 years and died; this is not a phenotype conflict. Patient 1 age at death is not stated precisely (death followed transplant at 21 years), so deceased_age_iso8601 is null. Patient 3 vital status is not stated explicitly. Subject D zygosity is printed as 'compound hereozygous phenotype' (typo in paper). n_patients_reported=3 follows 'We studied 3 LAD-1 patients'; 7 ITGB2-genotyped LAD-1 patients are described in total.
